name: Walton Bridge
summary: Walton Bridge is both a local landmark and one of the best viewpoints on this stretch of the Thames. Combine it with Cowey Sale, the riverside path and a ferry or boat trip for a simple Walton itinerary.
reasonToVisit: One of the best river viewpoints on this stretch of the Thames
planningDetail: Pairs naturally with Cowey Sale and a ferry or boat trip for a short itinerary
